label: History
value: Aunt Em originally came to live on the Kansas prairie.
unit: Aunt Em originally came to live on the Kansas prairie as a young, pretty wife, though the drab environment eventually transformed her into a gray, somber woman. When a severe cyclone struck their farm, she quickly took shelter in the cyclone cellar, but the storm swept away their house with Dorothy inside. Months later, she was joyfully reunited with Dorothy when her niece suddenly appeared on the farm after traveling back from the Land of Oz. She was later left at home in Kansas to take care of the farm and watch over the hired men when her frail husband, Uncle Henry, took Dorothy on a voyage to Australia.

label: History
value: Billina was raised on a farm in the United States.
unit: Raised on a farm in the United States, Billina was named Bill by a young boy who mistook her gender. She first met Dorothy Gale while floating at sea inside a hen-coop, where they introduced themselves and discovered she had gained the ability to speak. After drifting ashore in the Land of Ev, Billina accompanied Dorothy on her travels, surviving an ambush by the Wheelers and joining a quest with Princess Ozma to rescue the royal family of Ev from the Nome King. During their journey to the underworld, she laid an egg that the Scarecrow collected, and later snuck away to sleep beneath the Nome King's throne. While hiding, Billina overheard the King reveal that the Ev royal family had been turned into purple ornaments and the Oz travelers into green ones. Leveraging the Nome King's deadly fear of eggs after laying another in his throne room, she secured her turn to explore the palace, using her secret knowledge to successfully disenchant the royal family of Ev, Princess Ozma, the Scarecrow, and Tiktok. During the ensuing battle, her eggs were thrown at the Nome King and his army, blinding the King and allowing Dorothy to claim his magic belt. On the return journey, Billina recognized that Prince Evring's tin whistle was actually the missing Tin Woodman and spoke the magic word to restore him. Choosing to settle permanently in Oz rather than follow Dorothy to Australia, Billina took up residence in the Emerald City, where she was later reunited with Dorothy during a royal palace dinner.

unit: Raised on a farm in the United States, Billina was named Bill by a young boy who mistook her gender. She first met Dorothy Gale while floating at sea inside a hen-coop, where they introduced themselves and discovered she had gained the ability to speak. After drifting ashore in the Land of Ev, Billina accompanied Dorothy on her travels, surviving an ambush by the Wheelers and joining a quest with Princess Ozma to rescue the royal family of Ev from the Nome King. During their journey to the underworld, she laid an egg that the Scarecrow collected, and later snuck away to sleep beneath the Nome King's throne. While hiding, Billina overheard the King reveal that the Ev royal family had been turned into purple ornaments and the Oz travelers into green ones. Leveraging the Nome King's deadly fear of eggs after laying another in his throne room, she secured her turn to explore the palace, using her secret knowledge to successfully disenchant the royal family of Ev, Princess Ozma, the Scarecrow, and Tiktok. During the ensuing battle, her eggs were thrown at the Nome King and his army, blinding the King and allowing Dorothy to claim his magic belt. On the return journey, Billina recognized that Prince Evring's tin whistle was actually the missing Tin Woodman and spoke the magic word to restore him. Choosing to settle permanently in Oz rather than follow Dorothy to Australia, Billina took up residence in the Emerald City, where she was later reunited with Dorothy during a royal palace dinner.

label: Quote
value: Billina said: "Do you think I'd let that speckled villain of a rooster lord it over me, and claim to run this chicken house, as long as I'm able to peck and scratch? Not if my name is Bill!"

label: Quote
value: Billina said: "It is that cross old Princess who is to blame. But I was raised in the United States, and I won't allow any one-horse chicken of the Land of Ev to run over me and put on airs, as long as I can lift a claw in self-defense."

label: Quote
value: Billina said: "although Dorothy has put scollops on it and made it Billina. But the name doesn't matter. I've saved you from the Nome King, and you are a slave no longer."

label: Quote
value: Billina said: "Don't let their condition make you unhappy, ma'am, because I'll soon have them crowding 'round to bother and worry you as naturally as ever. Come with me, if you please, and I'll show you how pretty they look."

label: Quote
value: Billina said: "I must find Ozma. She is sure to be here, somewhere, and of course she is green, being from Oz. So look around, you stupid soldiers, and help me in my search."

label: Personality
value: The Woggle-Bug is a learned individual.
unit: The Woggle-Bug is a learned individual who exhibits a pompous demeanor, frequently strutting about in a futile attempt to look dignified. Fond of making puns, he finds the temptation to express them nearly irresistible. He was once driven by a desire to lay siege to the city and starve it into submission, and his extensive knowledge later leads to his appointment as the Public Accuser, a role suited to his ability to see through deception.

He was once driven by a desire to lay siege to the city and starve it into submission, and his extensive knowledge later leads to his appointment as the Public Accuser, a role suited to his ability to see through deception.

label: History
value: The Bug was born as an ordinary woggle-bug.
unit: Born as an ordinary woggle-bug, the Bug spent three years living in a school-house hearth, where he acquired an extensive education by listening to a schoolmaster. After being magnified by a professor on a screen and saving a tailor's ninth life, he escaped to a grove of trees and eventually joined Tip and his companions on their journey to the Emerald City. Along the way, he suggested using Jack Pumpkinhead's leg to repair the Saw-Horse, though his fondness for puns occasionally annoyed his fellow travelers. During their adventure, he successfully used one of Dr. Nikidik's Wishing Pills to repair the Gump's wings while trapped in a giant Jackdaw nest. After assisting Princess Ozma during her struggle to reclaim her father's throne, he established himself as a prominent figure in the Emerald City. When Dorothy's kitten Eureka was put on trial for the suspected murder of a piglet, the Woggle-Bug served as the prosecutor in the court proceeding, arguing the case until Eureka revealed the missing piglet was alive.

label: Quote
value: Bug said: "I have never ceased to congratulate myself for escaping while I was Highly Magnified; for even my excessive knowledge would have proved of little use to me had I remained a tiny, insignificant insect."

label: Quote
value: Bug said: "If the Pumpkinhead is to ride, why not use one of his legs to make a leg for the horse that carries him? I judge that both are made of wood."

label: Quote
value: Bug said: “But you were the King until she came,” said the Woggle-Bug, strutting up and down with his hands in his pockets; “so it appears to me that she is the interloper instead of you.”

label: Quote
value: Bug said: “As for me,” said the Woggle-Bug, “I think that I could live for some time on Jack Pumpkinhead. Not that I prefer pumpkins for food; but I believe they are somewhat nutritious, and Jack’s head is large and plump.”

label: Quote
value: Bug said: “You have; and I’ve restrained a good many of them,” replied the insect. “But there are opportunities for so many excellent puns in our language that, to an educated person like myself, the temptation to express them is almost irresistible.”

label: Personality
value: The Cowardly Lion describes himself as a wild beast.
unit: A self-described wild beast, the Cowardly Lion possesses a complex nature marked by feelings of cowardice and a fear of everything, though he is recognized for his loyalty and a braver disposition than most creatures. He harbors a deep fear of falling, danger, and the monstrous Kalidahs. He feels his life is unbearable without bravery, which he believes is necessary to truly become the King of Beasts as men call him. To achieve this, he seeks out Oz and the Wizard to beg for courage, specifically wanting the kind of courage that allows him to forget his fears.

label: History
value: Dorothy is an orphan
unit: Dorothy is an orphan from Kansas who originally lived on a dry, gray prairie with her Uncle Henry and Aunt Em. Her life changed dramatically when a severe cyclone lifted her house into the air and transported her and her dog Toto to the Land of Oz, where the landing house inadvertently crushed the Wicked Witch of the East. Guided by the Witch of the North, who gifted her silver shoes and a protective kiss, Dorothy set off along the yellow brick road toward the Emerald City to ask the Great Wizard Oz for help returning home. Along the way, she befriended and recruited a Scarecrow, a rusted Tin Woodman, and a Cowardly Lion, jointly overcoming dangerous chasms, fearsome Kalidahs, a sleeping poppy field, and a fierce wildcat. Upon reaching the Emerald City, Oz demanded that Dorothy and her friends destroy the Wicked Witch of the West before granting any wishes. During their quest, Dorothy was captured and forced into servitude at the Witch's castle until she threw a bucket of water on the villain, causing her to melt. After liberating the Winkies, repairing her companions, and discovering how to use the magic Golden Cap to command the Winged Monkeys, Dorothy returned to the Emerald City only to discover that Oz was an ordinary old man without real magic. When Oz accidentally departed in a hot-air balloon without her, Dorothy journeyed south through china and monster-infested lands to seek the aid of Glinda the Good Witch, who revealed that the silver shoes held the power to send her back to Kansas. Sometime after returning home, Dorothy was swept overboard during a sea storm while traveling to Australia with her uncle, ending up in the Land of Ev with a talking hen named Billina. Reunited with her old friends and Princess Ozma, Dorothy stole a magic belt from the blinded Nome King to rescue Ev's royal family before being named a Princess of Oz and wished safely back to Australia. Later, while riding in a buggy with her kitten Eureka and her friend Zeb during a severe earthquake, Dorothy was plunged deep into an underground abyss with six colored suns. Dorothy and her companions navigated subterranean worlds filled with vegetable Mangaboos, invisible bears in the Valley of Voe, silent wooden Gargoyles, and dangerous dragonettes.

Her life changed dramatically when a severe cyclone lifted her house into the air and transported her and her dog Toto to the Land of Oz, where the landing house inadvertently crushed the Wicked Witch of the East. Guided by the Witch of the North, who gifted her silver shoes and a protective kiss, Dorothy set off along the yellow brick road toward the Emerald City to ask the Great Wizard Oz for help returning home. Along the way, she befriended and recruited a Scarecrow, a rusted Tin Woodman, and a Cowardly Lion, jointly overcoming dangerous chasms, fearsome Kalidahs, a sleeping poppy field, and a fierce wildcat. Upon reaching the Emerald City, Oz demanded that Dorothy and her friends destroy the Wicked Witch of the West before granting any wishes. During their quest, Dorothy was captured and forced into servitude at the Witch's castle until she threw a bucket of water on the villain, causing her to melt. After liberating the Winkies, repairing her companions, and discovering how to use the magic Golden Cap to command the Winged Monkeys, Dorothy returned to the Emerald City only to discover that Oz was an ordinary old man without real magic. When Oz accidentally departed in a hot-air balloon without her, Dorothy journeyed south through china and monster-infested lands to seek the aid of Glinda the Good Witch, who revealed that the silver shoes held the power to send her back to Kansas. Sometime after returning home, Dorothy was swept overboard during a sea storm while traveling to Australia with her uncle, ending up in the Land of Ev with a talking hen named Billina. Reunited with her old friends and Princess Ozma, Dorothy stole a magic belt from the blinded Nome King to rescue Ev's royal family before being named a Princess of Oz and wished safely back to Australia. Later, while riding in a buggy with her kitten Eureka and her friend Zeb during a severe earthquake, Dorothy was plunged deep into an underground abyss with six colored suns. Dorothy and her companions navigated subterranean worlds filled with vegetable Mangaboos, invisible bears in the Valley of Voe, silent wooden Gargoyles, and dangerous dragonettes.

label: History
value: Eureka is a kitten
unit: Eureka, a kitten found and named by Dorothy Gale, plummeted into a deep subterranean abyss alongside Dorothy, Zeb, and Jim the cab-horse during a sudden earthquake. Landing in a underground glass city, Eureka gained the ability to speak and accompanied the group as they encountered the vegetable-like Mangaboo people. When the hostiles attempted to condemn the group's animals to the Black Pit, Eureka helped put up a fierce fight before eventually escaping a dark cave to fetch Dorothy, Zeb, and the Wizard of Oz to rescue her companions. She then traveled with the party across the water in the Valley of Voe, up Pyramid Mountain into the Country of the Gargoyles, and past a cavern of dragonettes. Trapped in a dead-end cave, Eureka was magically transported to the Emerald City alongside Dorothy when Princess Ozma used the Magic Belt. In Oz, Eureka was put on trial for murder when one of the Wizard's piglets went missing, acting defiant until she eventually revealed the missing piglet was alive and trapped inside a narrow vase in Ozma's room. Following her acquittal, Eureka returned home to Kansas with Dorothy via the Magic Belt.

label: Quote
value: Eureka said: "Why, they are driving us toward the Black Pit, into which they threatened to cast us," replied the kitten. "If I were as big as you are, Jim, I'd fight these miserable turnip-roots!"

label: Quote
value: Eureka said: "Almost on earth isn't being there," said the kitten, in a discontented tone. "It wouldn't be possible for even me to get up to that crack—or through it if I got there."

label: Quote
value: Eureka said: "I won't die cheerfully!" protested the kitten. "There's nothing cheerful about dying that I could ever see, although they say a cat has nine lives, and so must die nine times."

label: Quote
value: Eureka said: "and I also can see you again, and the sight makes me dreadfully hungry. Please, Mr. Wizard, may I eat just one of the fat little piglets? You'd never miss one of them, I'm sure!"

label: Quote
value: Eureka said: "I'll leave them alone. You haven't many teeth left, Jim, but the few you have are sharp enough to make me shudder. So the piglets will be perfectly safe, hereafter, as far as I am concerned."

label: History
value: General Jinjur spent her early life at home.
unit: Before rising to power, General Jinjur spent her early life at home making beds and washing dishes for her mother. Seeking a grander life, she organized an Army of Revolt made up entirely of young women and successfully captured the Emerald City. Her forces disarmed the guards, conquered the city without bloodshed, and drove the Scarecrow from the throne, after which Jinjur declared herself Queen and enlisted the witch Mombi to help defend her realm. After briefly losing control of the palace when the Scarecrow frightened her army with mice, Jinjur regained her footing until Glinda the Sorceress and Princess Ozma besieged the city. Jinjur fought a battle against Glinda's forces and steadfastly refused to step down, but she was ultimately captured during an aerial assault, conquered by Ozma, and removed from power. She later crossed paths again with Ozma's companions, meeting Dorothy Gale as the girl traveled across the desert on a magic carpet.

label: Quote
value: General Jinjur said: “There!” said she; “it is time for me to go. Carry that basket for me and help yourself to its contents if you are hungry.”

label: Quote
value: General Jinjur said: “Oh, no”, said Jinjur. “What man would oppose a girl, or dare to harm her? And there is not an ugly face in my entire Army.”

label: Quote
value: General Jinjur said: “To think,” she moaned, “that after having ruled as Queen, and lived in a palace, I must go back to scrubbing floors and churning butter again! It is too horrible to think of! I will never consent!”

label: Quote
value: General Jinjur said: "I have taken it, as you see; so just now I am the Queen, and all who oppose me are guilty of treason, and must be punished by the law you have just mentioned."

label: Quote
value: General Jinjur said: "The enemy is still outside the walls, so we must try to gain time by engaging them in parley. Go you with a flag of truce to Glinda and ask her why she has dared to invade my dominions, and what are her demands."

label: History
value: Glinda is a beautiful woman
unit: Glinda is a beautiful woman who has maintained her youthful appearance despite living for many years, and she previously conquered the evil Witch in the South. When Dorothy and her companions travel to her castle seeking aid, Glinda uses the Golden Cap to help Dorothy's friends reach their new homes and reveals that Dorothy's Silver Shoes can carry her back to Kansas. Later, Glinda resolves to help liberate the Emerald City by marching her army to depose Queen Jinjur and restore the throne to its rightful heir, Princess Ozma. She uncovers the hidden witch Mombi, pursues her across the desert on the Sawhorse, and uses a truth-detecting pearl to force Mombi into revealing she transformed Princess Ozma into the boy Tip. After overseeing Mombi's magic incantation to restore Ozma, Glinda leads an aerial assault to capture General Jinjur and end the revolt. When Dorothy later seeks a way to rejoin her sick uncle, Glinda advises Ozma on how to use the magic belt to transport Dorothy safely to Australia.

label: Quote
value: Glinda said: “By means of the Golden Cap I shall command the Winged Monkeys to carry you to the gates of the Emerald City,” said Glinda, “for it would be a shame to deprive the people of so wonderful a ruler.”

label: Quote
value: Glinda said: "yet I cannot understand how I have been defeated so easily by an old Witch who knows far less of magic than I do myself."

label: Quote
value: Glinda said: “That is true,” replied the Sorceress, slowly. “But the Emerald City is now ruled by General Jinjur, who has caused herself to be proclaimed Queen. What right have I to oppose her?”

label: Quote
value: Glinda said: “Then,” decided Glinda, “I will march with my army to the Emerald City, and take Mombi prisoner. After that we can, perhaps, force her to tell the truth about Ozma.”

label: Quote
value: Glinda said: “I am quite obstinate myself,” returned the Sorceress, with a sweet smile. “so I do not fear Mombi in the least. Today I will make all necessary preparations, and we will march upon the Emerald City at daybreak tomorrow.”

label: History
value: The Great Oz is known to the inhabitants of the land as a powerful ruler.
unit: Known to the inhabitants of the land as a powerful ruler, the Great Oz requires visitors to the Emerald City to wear green-tinted spectacles before granting them individual audiences in his palace. When Dorothy and her companions seek his help, he assumes a different magical form for each visitor—appearing as a giant Head, a winged Lady, a five-eyed Beast, and a Ball of Fire—and refuses to fulfill their wishes until they destroy the Wicked Witch of the West. Upon their return, Toto knocks over a screen in the throne room, exposing Oz as a non-magical ventriloquist and ordinary man from Omaha. After admitting he is a humbug who has been deceiving everyone, he promises to grant the group's requests the next day.

unit: When Dorothy and her companions first arrived at the Emerald City, the Guardian locked green-tinted spectacles onto each traveler before leading them inside the gates. He subsequently attached green spectacles to Jack Pumpkinhead and the Saw-Horse upon their arrival at the city and escorted Jack to see the Scarecrow. value: Guardian said: “Ouch!” cried the man; “I’m sorry I asked that question. But the answer is most convincing. Have you any errand, sir, in the Emerald City?”

value: Guardian said: "Here is a strange gentleman who doesn’t know why he has come to the Emerald City, or what he wants. Tell me, what shall we do with him?"

label: History
value: Gump was killed
unit: Once a monarch of the forest with swift legs, Gump was killed and his head was mounted on a wall. He was brought back to life when Tip sprinkled him with the Powder of Life to serve as the animated head of an improvised flying machine. After the Woggle-Bug used a wishing pill to repair his damaged wings, Gump carried the group on several missions, including helping Glinda capture Mombi and flying an aerial assault on the Emerald City to restore Princess Ozma to the throne. At his own request, Gump was subsequently dismantled, though his living head was put back on the palace wall, where he later conversed with Dorothy.

label: Appearance
value: The Saw-Horse is an animated wooden steed.
unit: The Saw-Horse is an animated wooden steed made from a log with four stiff, wooden stick legs driven into bored holes, lacking knee-joints and shod at the ends with plates of solid gold. Its head consists of a hard wooden knot formed from one projecting end of its long body, with a chopped place that serves as a mouth and no ears. It possesses bulging, queer, protruding eyes that are mere knots of wood in the log. Its tail consists of a small tree branch that was left on the wood by accident.

value: The Saw-Horse acts without fear.
unit: The Saw-Horse is an obedient and patient creature who acts without fear, as he does not understand what danger means. Though initially considered quite stupid, he is also known to be obstinate and very wise. He possesses remarkable physical capabilities, as he never tires, does not need to eat or breathe, and is entirely unable to feel pain. Furthermore, he is an exceptionally swift runner, able to trot as fast as Jim with wooden legs that move so rapidly their motion can scarcely be seen.

label: History
value: The Saw-Horse was brought to life when Tip used Mombi's magic Powder of Life on him.
unit: Brought to life when Tip used Mombi's magic Powder of Life on him, the Saw-Horse had wooden ears carved by Tip so he could hear and speak, as well as a peg hammered into his back as a handhold. Early in his travels, he proved so fast that he accidentally snapped off his own tail in Tip's hands before carrying Jack Pumpkinhead into the Emerald City. He subsequently carried Tip, Jack, and the Scarecrow out of the city during General Jinjur's rebellion, swimming across a river and journeying to the Tin Woodman's palace. While traversing the countryside, the Saw-Horse broke his leg in a rabbit hole, which was repaired using one of Jack's wooden legs. After escaping a giant Jackdaw nest, the Saw-Horse helped the travelers figure out how to activate Dr. Nikidik's Wishing Pills by completing a counting requirement. During a chase across the desert to capture the shapeshifting witch Mombi, Glinda rode the Saw-Horse to pursue Mombi's Griffin form until the witch collapsed from exhaustion. Later fitted with golden plates on his hooves by Ozma to prevent his legs from wearing out, the Saw-Horse eventually met Jim the horse in the Emerald City. After defeating Jim in a formal race, the Saw-Horse was kicked by the frustrated real horse before Ozma officially crowned him as the Prince of Horses.

unit: Brought to life when Tip used Mombi's magic Powder of Life on him, the Saw-Horse had wooden ears carved by Tip so he could hear and speak, as well as a peg hammered into his back as a handhold. Early in his travels, he proved so fast that he accidentally snapped off his own tail in Tip's hands before carrying Jack Pumpkinhead into the Emerald City. He subsequently carried Tip, Jack, and the Scarecrow out of the city during General Jinjur's rebellion, swimming across a river and journeying to the Tin Woodman's palace. While traversing the countryside, the Saw-Horse broke his leg in a rabbit hole, which was repaired using one of Jack's wooden legs. After escaping a giant Jackdaw nest, the Saw-Horse helped the travelers figure out how to activate Dr. Nikidik's Wishing Pills by completing a counting requirement. During a chase across the desert to capture the shapeshifting witch Mombi, Glinda rode the Saw-Horse to pursue Mombi's Griffin form until the witch collapsed from exhaustion. Later fitted with golden plates on his hooves by Ozma to prevent his legs from wearing out, the Saw-Horse eventually met Jim the horse in the Emerald City. After defeating Jim in a formal race, the Saw-Horse was kicked by the frustrated real horse before Ozma officially crowned him as the Prince of Horses.

label: Quote
value: Horse said: “Well, I cannot claim any great experience in life,” the Saw-Horse answered for himself. “but I seem to learn very quickly, and often it occurs to me that I know more than any of those around me.”

label: Quote
value: Horse said: "Oh, no," answered the Sawhorse. "I merely said it wasn't fair. But if my friend the Real Horse is willing to undertake the race I am quite ready."

label: Quote
value: Horse said: "I couldn't help it," returned the other, rather crestfallen. "Ozma sprinkled me with a magic powder, and I just had to live. I know I'm not much account; but I'm the only horse in all the Land of Oz, so they treat me with great respect."

label: Quote
value: Horse said: "Oh, I cannot hope ever to be like you," sighed the Sawhorse. "But I am glad to meet at last a Real Horse. You are certainly the most beautiful creature I ever beheld."

label: Quote
value: Horse said: "I can see the bones all right," replied the Sawhorse, "and they are admirable and distinct. Also I can see the flesh. But the blood, I suppose, is tucked away inside."

label: History
value: The Hungry Tiger was born hungry.
unit: Born hungry, the Hungry Tiger left the forest and joined his friend, the Cowardly Lion. He accompanied Dorothy Gale, Princess Ozma, and their companions on a dangerous quest into the Nome King's underground realm to rescue the royal family of Ev. When the enraged Nome King ordered his warriors to capture Dorothy, the Tiger, the Lion, and the Sawhorse stepped forward to defend her. Following their victory, he crossed the desert back to the Emerald City, where Dorothy was named a Princess of Oz. He later welcomed Dorothy upon her return to the Emerald City and attended a grand parade and outdoor games in honor of the city's visitors. During the games, the Tiger knocked over Jim the horse after Jim angrily kicked the Sawhorse. He was subsequently present for the court trial of Dorothy's kitten Eureka, who was accused of eating one of the Wizard's piglets before revealing the piglet was safe.

unit: Born hungry, the Hungry Tiger left the forest and joined his friend, the Cowardly Lion. He accompanied Dorothy Gale, Princess Ozma, and their companions on a dangerous quest into the Nome King's underground realm to rescue the royal family of Ev. When the enraged Nome King ordered his warriors to capture Dorothy, the Tiger, the Lion, and the Sawhorse stepped forward to defend her. Following their victory, he crossed the desert back to the Emerald City, where Dorothy was named a Princess of Oz. He later welcomed Dorothy upon her return to the Emerald City and attended a grand parade and outdoor games in honor of the city's visitors. During the games, the Tiger knocked over Jim the horse after Jim angrily kicked the Sawhorse. He was subsequently present for the court trial of Dorothy's kitten Eureka, who was accused of eating one of the Wizard's piglets before revealing the piglet was safe.

label: Quote
value: Hungry Tiger said: "For my part, I'm a savage beast, and have an appetite for all sorts of poor little living creatures, from a chipmonk to fat babies."

label: Quote
value: Hungry Tiger said: "My, my! how good you would taste if I could only crunch you between my jaws. But don't worry. You would only appease my appetite for a moment; so it isn't worth while to eat you."

label: Quote
value: Hungry Tiger said: "Then," said the Tiger, yawning frightfully, "please to get me about thirty pounds of tenderloin steak, cooked rare, with a peck of boiled potatoes on the side, and five gallons of ice-cream for dessert."

label: Quote
value: Hungry Tiger said: "A bushel of them, hard boiled, might take a little of the edge off my appetite; but one egg isn't good for anything at all, that I know of."

label: Quote
value: Hungry Tiger said: "A nice, plump, juicy, tender, fat baby. But, of course, if I had one, my conscience would not allow me to eat it. So I'll have to be an ornament and forget my hunger."

label: History
value: Jack Pumpkinhead was constructed as a wooden dummy.
unit: Jack Pumpkinhead was constructed as a wooden dummy with a carved pumpkin head by the young boy Tip, who built him in the Gillikin region of Oz to prank the old sorceress Mombi. Mombi subsequently brought Jack to life using a magical powder. Fearing Mombi's plans to turn him into a statue, Tip fled with Jack toward the Emerald City. To facilitate their journey, Tip animated a wooden sawhorse for Jack to ride. Separated from Tip along the way, Jack arrived in the city first and formed a friendship with the Scarecrow after clearing up a language misunderstanding.

label: History
value: Jack escaped from the city when Jinjur's army invaded.
unit: When Jinjur's army invaded the city, Jack escaped alongside Tip, the Scarecrow, and the Tin Woodman on the Saw-Horse, though his jointed legs required occasional repair and replacement during their travels. After joining forces with the Woggle-Bug and the Queen of the Field Mice, Jack participated in an attempt to retake the palace, which resulted in the group becoming trapped inside. He was then carried aboard an animated flying Gump machine built on the palace roof. When the machine crashed into a giant Jackdaw nest, the Scarecrow covered Jack's head with his own straw body to protect him from attacking birds. value: Jack Pumpkinhead said: “My name is Jack Pumpkinhead,” returned the other, smilingly; “but as to my business, I haven’t the least idea in the world what it is.”

value: Jack Pumpkinhead said: “It seems to me that I have,” replied the Pumpkinhead, seriously; “but I cannot think what it is. My father knows all about it, but he is not here.”

label: Quote
value: Jack Pumpkinhead said: “But I hope she cannot get at us,” exclaimed the Pumpkinhead, with a shiver of fear. “She threatened to make tarts of me, you know.”

label: Quote
value: Jack Pumpkinhead said: “Oh, dear!” moaned Jack; “what an unhappy lot is mine! Why, dear father, did you not make me out of tin—or even out of straw—so that I would keep indefinitely.”

label: Quote
value: Jack Pumpkinhead said: “First, however,” said the Pumpkinhead, “I beg you will release me from this horse, and make me another leg to walk with. For in my present condition I am of no use to myself or to anyone else.”

label: History
value: Jellia Jamb is a resident of Oz
unit: Jellia Jamb is a resident of Oz who was born in the North Country. While serving at the palace in the Emerald City, she briefly acted as an interpreter between Jack Pumpkinhead and the Scarecrow, using the opportunity to tease them before revealing they spoke the same language. During Queen Jinjur's reign, the witch Mombi magically disguised Jellia as herself to fool Glinda's surrounding army, though Glinda immediately saw through the deception. She later welcomed the Wizard, Zeb, and Jim upon their arrival at the royal palace, ensuring Jim was given a room inside.

label: History
value: Jim was born in Kentucky.
unit: Born in Kentucky, Jim was a former race horse who won every race in his youth before spending years drawing a public cab in Chicago. Treated as a servant since birth, he was pulling a buggy with Zeb to meet Dorothy when a sudden earthquake plunged them, along with the buggy, into an underground abyss. During their descent to a subterranean city of glass, Jim gained the ability to speak. After the native Mangaboos attempted to banish the group's animals to the Black Pit, Jim fought fiercely, but he and the others were cornered in a cave before escaping through a mountain tunnel. Jim pulled the buggy across dangerous underground lands, kicked at attacking wooden Gargoyles, and flew the group to safety using stolen wooden wings wired to his body and the buggy. Trapped in a dead-end cave, Jim and his companions were rescued when Princess Ozma magically transported them to the Emerald City. In Oz, Jim demanded raw oatmeal, met the Sawhorse, and was beaten by the Sawhorse in a public race; in anger, Jim kicked his opponent and was knocked over by the Hungry Tiger. Ultimately, Ozma used her Magic Belt to return Jim and Zeb back to Hugson's Ranch.

label: Quote
value: Jim said: "Bah!" cried Jim, looking with great disdain at the other; "do you imagine for an instant that such a shabby imitation of a horse as you are can run as fast as I?"

label: Quote
value: Jim said: "Once, when I was young," said Jim, "I was a race horse, and defeated all who dared run against me. I was born in Kentucky, you know, where all the best and most aristocratic horses come from."

label: Quote
value: Jim said: "Old! Why, I feel like a colt today," replied Jim. "I only wish there was a real horse here for me to race with. I'd show the people a fine sight, I can tell you."

label: Quote
value: Jim said: "I beg your pardon, I'm sure," said Jim, meekly. "I was wrong to kick the Sawhorse, and I am sorry I became angry at him. He has won the race, and won it fairly; but what can a horse of flesh do against a tireless beast of wood?"

label: Quote
value: Jim said: "I ought to be a fairy," grumbled Jim, as he slowly drew the buggy home; "for to be just an ordinary horse in a fairy country is to be of no account whatever. It's no place for us, Zeb."

label: History
value: Princess Langwidere was a niece of King Evoldo
unit: Princess Langwidere was a niece of the late King Evoldo who ruled the Land of Ev and possessed thirty changeable heads stored in a cabinet. When Dorothy, Tiktok, and Billina arrived at her palace, Langwidere put on an ill-tempered head and demanded Dorothy's head for her collection; upon Dorothy's refusal, Langwidere had her army arrest the group and locked Dorothy in the North Tower. Princess Ozma of Oz later arrived at the palace and forced Langwidere to release Dorothy and her companions. When Ozma organized an expedition to rescue Ev's royal family from the Nome King, Langwidere declined to join the quest, remaining behind at her palace where she was eventually present when Prince Evardo was crowned the new King of Ev.

Having learned magic tricks from the Wizard of Oz and obtained the Powder of Life from Nikidik, she raised Tip until he escaped her household with the powder after learning she intended to turn him into a statue. Mombi later aligned with General Jinjur to protect her reign over the Emerald City, using various magical illusions and shapeshifting spells to delay her enemies and evade capture. Glinda the Good eventually pursued Mombi across the desert, forcing her to collapse from exhaustion and capturing her with a golden thread. Under interrogation with Glinda's truth-detecting pearl, Mombi confessed her past actions and performed the required incantation to break Tip's enchantment, restoring Princess Ozma to her true identity.

value: Mombi said: "He taught me all the magical tricks he knew. Some were good tricks, and some were only frauds; but I have remained faithful to my promise."

value: Mombi said: "The Wizard brought to me the girl Ozma, who was then no more than a baby, and begged me to conceal the child."

value: Mombi said: "And then I can tell whether that crooked wizard has fairly traded secrets, or whether he has fooled me as wickedly as I fooled him."

value: Mombi said: "And now let us see if it is potent. The stingy wizard didn’t give me much of it, but I guess there’s enough for two or three doses."

label: History
value: Nick Chopper was born a real man.
unit: Born a real man, Nick Chopper acquired his tin body gradually after experiencing numerous axe accidents, and he later destroyed the Wicked Witch's Grey Wolves before being invited to rule over the Winkies. He joined his old friends to help reclaim the Emerald City from General Jinjur's rebellion, aiding their escape by repairing Jack Pumpkinhead's leg with a table leg and constructing a flying machine called the Gump. During a later pursuit, a rose he wore was revealed to be the disguised witch Mombi, leading to her capture by Glinda. While travelling on a mission in Ev, Nick was transformed into a tin pig whistle by the Nome King until Billina recognized him and used a magic word to restore him to his original form.

label: General Jinjur
value: General Jinjur is an enemy of Nick Chopper.
unit: General Jinjur is an enemy of Nick Chopper, having seized the Emerald City with her Army of Revolt and held Nick and his allies prisoner in the royal palace. When Jinjur ambushed the group and threatened them with execution, Nick helped secure the palace doors after the Scarecrow scattered mice to panic the rebels. Jinjur later allied with the witch Mombi, whom Nick unknowingly wore as a rose before Mombi was unmasked and captured by Glinda.

Furthermore, she demonstrates a commitment to rescuing the Queen of Ev and her ten children, willing to face risks to free the royal family from the Nome King.

label: History
value: Princess Ozma was reared by the witch Mombi from childhood.
unit: Reared by the witch Mombi from childhood, Princess Ozma was transformed at birth into a boy named Tip so her true identity as the rightful ruler of Oz would remain hidden. While living as Tip, she brought a sawhorse to life with a witch-powder and sprinkled the Gump with the Powder of Life. After Glinda captured Mombi, the witch confessed her actions and broke the enchantment, restoring Tip to her original identity as Princess Ozma. Following an aerial assault to remove General Jinjur from power, Ozma was crowned Queen of the Emerald City.

label: History
value: Ozma led an expedition
unit: Later, Ozma led an expedition to the realm of the Nome King to rescue the captive royal family of Ev. Accepting the Nome King's terms, she attempted to guess which ornaments were the transformed royals, but failed and was turned into an emerald grasshopper ornament herself. After being restored by Billina, she helped her party escape with the Nome King's Magic Belt. Upon returning to the Emerald City, Ozma used the belt to send her friend Dorothy back to her family. When Dorothy eventually returned to Oz alongside the Wizard and other travelers, Ozma hosted them, offered the Wizard a permanent position as Official Wizard, and presided over a formal trial when one of the Wizard's piglets went missing. After the lost piglet was safely located, Ozma utilized the Magic Belt once more to transport Dorothy, Zeb, and their animal companions safely back to their respective homes.

value: Ozma said: "Your Majesty," said she, "I am the ruler of the Land of Oz, and I have come here to ask you to release the good Queen of Ev and her ten children, whom you have enchanted and hold as your prisoners."

value: Ozma said: "It would be foolish for us to fight," the girl said to the Tin Woodman. "For our brave Twenty-Seven would be quickly destroyed. I'm sure I do not know how to act in this emergency."

label: Quote
value: Ozma said: "I am very anxious," she continued, "to liberate the Queen of Ev and her children who are now ornaments and bric-a-brac in your Majesty's palace, and to restore them to their people. Tell me, sir, how this may be accomplished."

label: Quote
value: Ozma said: "But we have not yet found my faithful follower, the Tin Woodman," said Ozma to Dorothy, "and without him I do not wish to go away."

label: Personality
value: The Scarecrow is happy.

Being stuffed with straw, he does not need to eat, sleep, or rest, and he is able to see as well in the dark as he can by day. Because of his flammable nature, his only fear in the world is fire or a lighted match, which could easily destroy him. Calm under all circumstances, he possesses a thoughtful and philosophical nature, believing that brains are far superior to money. His initial driving motivation was to reach the Emerald City and obtain brains from the Great Oz so he could become like other men. In addition to helping his friend Dorothy, he was motivated to rule the Emerald City, save his friends, reunite with the Tin Woodman, and reclaim his throne from the Army of Revolt.

unit: Happy and contented, the Scarecrow is a gay, charming, and dignified individual who is known as the wisest personage in the Land of Oz. Being stuffed with straw, he does not need to eat, sleep, or rest, and he is able to see as well in the dark as he can by day. Because of his flammable nature, his only fear in the world is fire or a lighted match, which could easily destroy him. Calm under all circumstances, he possesses a thoughtful and philosophical nature, believing that brains are far superior to money. His initial driving motivation was to reach the Emerald City and obtain brains from the Great Oz so he could become like other men. In addition to helping his friend Dorothy, he was motivated to rule the Emerald City, save his friends, reunite with the Tin Woodman, and reclaim his throne from the Army of Revolt.

label: History
value: The Scarecrow originated as a straw-stuffed figure created on a pole in a Munchkin farmer's cornfield.
unit: Originating as a straw-stuffed figure created on a pole in a Munchkin farmer's cornfield, the Scarecrow was rescued by Dorothy Gale and joined her journey along the yellow brick road to seek brains from the Great Oz. Throughout their travels, he repeatedly used his cleverness to save his companions, including rescuing Dorothy from stinging bees and directing the defeat of the Kalidahs. Upon reaching the Emerald City and eventually discovering Oz was a human humbug, the Scarecrow received a simulated brain of bran and pins from Oz and was appointed King of the Emerald City when Oz departed in a balloon. He ruled until General Jinjur and her army of women staged a revolt and deposed him from the throne. Escaping on the Saw-Horse, he recruited the Tin Woodman and allied with Glinda to defeat the rebels, ultimately relinquishing his crown when Princess Ozma was restored as the rightful ruler. He later accompanied Ozma's expedition to the Nome King's underground realm to rescue the royal family of Ev, where he narrowly escaped permanent transformation into a palace ornament thanks to Billina the hen. Following their successful return to the Emerald City, the Scarecrow resumed his place as a prominent figure in Oz, participating in the grand celebrations, public games, and legal proceedings held during Dorothy's subsequent visits.

label: Quote
value: Scarecrow said: “I don’t know enough,” replied the Scarecrow cheerfully. “My head is stuffed with straw, you know, and that is why I am going to Oz to ask him for some brains.”

label: Quote
value: Scarecrow said: “All the same,” said the Scarecrow, “I shall ask for brains instead of a heart; for a fool would not know what to do with a heart if he had one.”

label: Quote
value: Scarecrow said: "and he would never hurt anyone who is our friend. If you will help us to save him I promise that he shall treat you all with kindness."

label: Quote
value: Scarecrow said: “I will return to the Emerald City,” he replied, “for Oz has made me its ruler and the people like me. The only thing that worries me is how to cross the hill of the Hammer-Heads.”

label: Quote
value: Scarecrow said: "How delighted I shall be to see my old friend the Tin Woodman again! I hope that he rules his people more successfully than I have ruled mine!"

label: Cowardly Lion
value: The Scarecrow and the Cowardly Lion are close friends.
unit: The Scarecrow and the Cowardly Lion are close friends and long-standing traveling companions, having bonded while journeying along the yellow brick road to seek gifts from the Great Oz. Throughout their travels, the Scarecrow has helped engineer rescues for the Lion, such as devising a plan with field mice to haul him out of a deadly field of sleeping poppies. Their shared devotion to Dorothy and mutual concern for each other's safety solidify their steadfast allegiance as comrades.

label: History
value: The Nome King acquired the royal family of Ev from King Evoldo.
unit: The Nome King acquired the royal family of Ev from King Evoldo in exchange for granting him a long life, subsequently transforming the Queen and her children into decorative ornaments for his underground cavern palace. When Ozma came to demand their release, the King refused and tricked her and her followers into a high-stakes guessing game that resulted in their transformation into ornaments as well. However, Billina discovered how to reverse his enchantments and freed the captives, after which the Scarecrow threw eggs at the King to exploit his fatal fear of them. Blinded and terrified by the eggs, the helpless Nome King was stripped of his magical belt by Dorothy, leaving him powerless as Ozma's party made their escape.

However, Billina discovered how to reverse his enchantments and freed the captives, after which the Scarecrow threw eggs at the King to exploit his fatal fear of them. Blinded and terrified by the eggs, the helpless Nome King was stripped of his magical belt by Dorothy, leaving him powerless as Ozma's party made their escape.

label: Quote
value: The King said: "Sit down, my dears," said the King, "and tell me why you have come all this way to see me, and what I can do to make you happy."

label: Quote
value: The King said: "Oh, no; you are mistaken about that," replied the King. "They are not my prisoners, but my slaves, whom I purchased from the King of Ev."

label: Quote
value: The King said: "According to the laws of Ev, the king can do no wrong," answered the monarch, eyeing a ring of smoke he had just blown from his mouth; "so that he had a perfect right to sell his family to me in exchange for a long life."

label: Quote
value: The King said: "That was not my fault," said the Nome King, crossing his legs and smiling contentedly. "I gave him the long life, all right; but he destroyed it."

label: Quote
value: The King said: "Of course not," the Nome King returned. "Nor will I give up the Queen and her children because the King of Ev destroyed his long life by jumping into the sea. They belong to me and I shall keep them."

value: The Queen of the Field Mice was rescued from a wildcat by the Tin Woodman.
unit: After being rescued from a wildcat by the Tin Woodman, the Queen of the Field Mice offered her gratitude and the help of her subjects to his companions. She gathered thousands of mice to pull a wooden cart, successfully hauling the sleeping Cowardly Lion out of a dangerous poppy field to safety. Later, she encountered the travelers again on their journey and lent twelve mice to hide in the Scarecrow's straw. She then guided the group past several of Mombi's magical illusions, leading them safely to the outside of the Emerald City.

label: History
value: Tiktok is a mechanical copper man.
unit: Tiktok is a mechanical copper man constructed in Evna by the firm of Smith & Tinker, who fitted him with Improved Combination Steel Brains and named him for the constant ticking of his clockwork. He never sleeps and requires winding in three separate mechanisms—thinking, speaking, and action—to remain active. Locked behind a hidden rock door, he was discovered by Dorothy Gale and Billina, who wound him up and accepted his pledge of service. He guided them safely past the Wheelers toward Evna, defending Dorothy until his action mechanism ran down during a clash with Princess Langwidere's army. After being rewound, Tiktok joined Princess Ozma's expedition into the Nome King's realm to rescue the royal family of Ev. In the Nome King's underground palace, Tiktok entered the high-stakes transformation room to make his guesses, but his mechanism ran down before he could succeed. He was later rescued from the king's enchantments by Billina and returned to the Emerald City with Ozma's party. When Dorothy eventually used magic to rejoin her family in Australia, she left Tiktok in Ozma's care.

label: Appearance
value: The Tin Woodman possesses a brilliantly polished body.
unit: The Tin Woodman possesses a brilliantly polished body composed entirely of pieces of tin that are neatly soldered and riveted together into the form of a man. His nickel-plated frame shines magnificently, featuring nickel cheeks, and he wears a diamond necklace. Carrying a gleaming axe over his right shoulder, he is also distinguished by a funnel-shaped cap tipped carelessly over his left ear.

label: Personality
value: The Tin Woodman is remarkably kind-hearted.
unit: The Tin Woodman is a remarkably kind-hearted, tender, and sensitive figure who is immensely proud yet entirely lacking in vanity. Known for his cheerful disposition and love of flowers, he is strongly averse to killing and constantly advocates for kindness, even in times of judgment. He originally set out with a deep desire to gain a heart from the Great Oz, believing a loving heart to be far more desirable than education or brains, so that he could marry a Munchkin maiden. Driven to be useful to Dorothy and to reach the Emerald City, he also held an ambition to return to the West and rule over the Winkies, who were fond of him. In addition to being a popular favorite among the people, he possesses practical talent as a skillful mechanic.

He originally set out with a deep desire to gain a heart from the Great Oz, believing a loving heart to be far more desirable than education or brains, so that he could marry a Munchkin maiden. Driven to be useful to Dorothy and to reach the Emerald City, he also held an ambition to return to the West and rule over the Winkies, who were fond of him. In addition to being a popular favorite among the people, he possesses practical talent as a skillful mechanic.

label: History
value: Tin Woodman is the son of a woodman.
unit: Born the son of a woodman, the Tin Woodman grew up to become a wood-chopper himself, caring for his mother until her death. Originally made of flesh, he was transformed into tin and lost his heart after the Wicked Witch of the East cursed his axe. Left rusted and motionless in a forest for a year following a rainstorm, he was rescued when Dorothy oiled his joints, after which he joined her journey to seek a heart from Oz. Along the way, he saved the Queen of the Field Mice from a wildcat and built a wooden truck so her subjects could haul the Cowardly Lion from a deadly poppy field. Upon reaching the Emerald City, Oz appeared to him as a five-eyed Beast and demanded the destruction of the Wicked Witch of the West before granting his wish. Though destroyed by Winged Monkeys during the quest, he was repaired by Winkie tinsmiths following the Witch's defeat, and he subsequently received a silk heart from Oz. After helping Dorothy navigate past aggressive trees and china territory to reach Glinda, he was chosen to rule the Winkies while Dorothy returned to Kansas. He later joined the Scarecrow to help defend the Emerald City against General Jinjur's army, unwittingly carrying Mombi disguised as a rose out of the city before Jinjur was overthrown. Later, while traveling with Ozma to the Nome King's realm to rescue the royal family of Ev, he was transformed into a tin pig whistle until Billina disenchanted him. Eventually returning to the Emerald City, he participated in celebrating Dorothy's return and acted as the defense lawyer during Eureka the kitten's trial.

Originally made of flesh, he was transformed into tin and lost his heart after the Wicked Witch of the East cursed his axe. Left rusted and motionless in a forest for a year following a rainstorm, he was rescued when Dorothy oiled his joints, after which he joined her journey to seek a heart from Oz. Along the way, he saved the Queen of the Field Mice from a wildcat and built a wooden truck so her subjects could haul the Cowardly Lion from a deadly poppy field. Upon reaching the Emerald City, Oz appeared to him as a five-eyed Beast and demanded the destruction of the Wicked Witch of the West before granting his wish. Though destroyed by Winged Monkeys during the quest, he was repaired by Winkie tinsmiths following the Witch's defeat, and he subsequently received a silk heart from Oz. After helping Dorothy navigate past aggressive trees and china territory to reach Glinda, he was chosen to rule the Winkies while Dorothy returned to Kansas. He later joined the Scarecrow to help defend the Emerald City against General Jinjur's army, unwittingly carrying Mombi disguised as a rose out of the city before Jinjur was overthrown. Later, while traveling with Ozma to the Nome King's realm to rescue the royal family of Ev, he was transformed into a tin pig whistle until Billina disenchanted him. Eventually returning to the Emerald City, he participated in celebrating Dorothy's return and acted as the defense lawyer during Eureka the kitten's trial.

label: Quote
value: Tin Woodman said: “Yes,” answered the tin man, “I did. I’ve been groaning for more than a year, and no one has ever heard me before or come to help me.”

label: Quote
value: Tin Woodman said: “Get an oil-can and oil my joints,” he answered. “They are rusted so badly that I cannot move them at all; if I am well oiled I shall soon be all right again. You will find an oil-can on a shelf in my cottage.”

label: Quote
value: Tin Woodman said: “This is a great comfort,” he said. “I have been holding that axe in the air ever since I rusted, and I’m glad to be able to put it down at last. Now, if you will oil the joints of my legs, I shall be all right once more.”

label: Quote
value: Tin Woodman said: “I might have stood there always if you had not come along,” he said; “so you have certainly saved my life. How did you happen to be here?”

label: Quote
value: Tin Woodman said: “True,” the Tin Woodman returned. “So, if you will allow me to join your party, I will also go to the Emerald City and ask Oz to help me.”

label: History
value: Toto is a small dog.
unit: Toto is a small, playful dog who used to love chasing mice when he lived in Kansas with Dorothy, Aunt Em, and Uncle Henry. His life changes dramatically when a severe cyclone strikes the farm; delayed while retrieving Toto, Dorothy is trapped inside their house as it is lifted away into the sky. The house lands in the Land of Oz, starting a long journey along the yellow brick road toward the Emerald City alongside Dorothy, the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, and the Cowardly Lion. During their adventures, Toto faces threats from wild beasts, survives the magical sleeping spell of a poppy field, and is captured alongside Dorothy by the Wicked Witch of the West's Winged Monkeys. After Dorothy destroys the Witch, Toto returns to the Emerald City with the group and inadvertently reveals the truth about the Great Oz by knocking over a screen in the throne room, exposing him as an ordinary man. Shortly after, Toto accidentally runs off right as a hot-air balloon is about to carry Dorothy and the Wizard home, causing Dorothy to miss the departure. He continues with Dorothy through China Country and Quadling land until Glinda the Good Witch teaches Dorothy how to use her Silver Shoes, allowing Toto and Dorothy to return safely to Kansas.

The house lands in the Land of Oz, starting a long journey along the yellow brick road toward the Emerald City alongside Dorothy, the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, and the Cowardly Lion. During their adventures, Toto faces threats from wild beasts, survives the magical sleeping spell of a poppy field, and is captured alongside Dorothy by the Wicked Witch of the West's Winged Monkeys. After Dorothy destroys the Witch, Toto returns to the Emerald City with the group and inadvertently reveals the truth about the Great Oz by knocking over a screen in the throne room, exposing him as an ordinary man. Shortly after, Toto accidentally runs off right as a hot-air balloon is about to carry Dorothy and the Wizard home, causing Dorothy to miss the departure. He continues with Dorothy through China Country and Quadling land until Glinda the Good Witch teaches Dorothy how to use her Silver Shoes, allowing Toto and Dorothy to return safely to Kansas.

label: History
value: The Wicked Witch ruled over the Winkies in the West.
unit: The Wicked Witch ruled over the Winkies in the West from her castle and held a power over them through force and magical artifacts. When Dorothy and her companions traveled west to destroy her, the Witch spotted them and dispatched waves of wolves, crows, bees, and Winkie soldiers to destroy the group. After those attempts failed, she used the Golden Cap to command the Winged Monkeys to destroy the Scarecrow and Tin Woodman, capture the Lion, and bring Dorothy to her castle as a servant. After tricking Dorothy into losing one of her silver shoes, an argument broke out that led Dorothy to throw a bucket of water on the Witch, causing her to melt away completely and ending her tyranny.

label: History
value: Oscar Zoroaster Phadrig Isaac Norman Henkle Emmannuel Ambroise Diggs was born in Omaha.
unit: Born in Omaha, Oscar Zoroaster Phadrig Isaac Norman Henkle Emmannuel Ambroise Diggs ran away as a young man to join a circus as a ventriloquist and wizard. During a balloon ascent to draw crowds, his balloon's ropes twisted, carrying him away to the Land of Oz, where locals mistook him for a wizard. He usurped the throne from King Pastoria, built the Emerald City and royal palace, taught Mombi magic, and hid Princess Ozma before escaping back to his former life in a balloon. Years later, after acquiring nine tiny piglets from the Island of Teenty-Weent, his balloon descended into a subterranean glass city following an earthquake, reuniting him with Dorothy. He used his piglets and a sword to defeat Gwig the Sorcerer, helped pick a new Princess from a bush, and used fire to intimidate the vegetable inhabitants. When trapped in the Black Pit, he escaped with the group through underground realms, fighting off wooden Gargoyles and ascending Pyramid Mountain. After being magically transported from a dead-end cave to the Emerald City by Princess Ozma, he accepted her offer to remain as Official Wizard. He performed magic tricks for the city's residents and later attempted to protect Dorothy's kitten during a trial by providing a spare piglet to fake the missing piglet's survival, until the real piglet was found safely inside a vase.

unit: Born in Omaha, Oscar Zoroaster Phadrig Isaac Norman Henkle Emmannuel Ambroise Diggs ran away as a young man to join a circus as a ventriloquist and wizard. During a balloon ascent to draw crowds, his balloon's ropes twisted, carrying him away to the Land of Oz, where locals mistook him for a wizard. He usurped the throne from King Pastoria, built the Emerald City and royal palace, taught Mombi magic, and hid Princess Ozma before escaping back to his former life in a balloon. Years later, after acquiring nine tiny piglets from the Island of Teenty-Weent, his balloon descended into a subterranean glass city following an earthquake, reuniting him with Dorothy. He used his piglets and a sword to defeat Gwig the Sorcerer, helped pick a new Princess from a bush, and used fire to intimidate the vegetable inhabitants. When trapped in the Black Pit, he escaped with the group through underground realms, fighting off wooden Gargoyles and ascending Pyramid Mountain. After being magically transported from a dead-end cave to the Emerald City by Princess Ozma, he accepted her offer to remain as Official Wizard. He performed magic tricks for the city's residents and later attempted to protect Dorothy's kitten during a trial by providing a spare piglet to fake the missing piglet's survival, until the real piglet was found safely inside a vase.

value: Wizard said: “Well, I’m not sure about Kansas,” said Oz, “for I haven’t the faintest notion which way it lies. But the first thing to do is to cross the desert, and then it should be easy to find your way home.”

value: Wizard said: "But you are in need of a Sorcerer," said the Wizard, "and not one of those growing is yet ripe enough to pick. I am greater than any thorn-covered sorcerer that ever grew in your garden. Why destroy me?"

value: The Wonderful Wizard built the Emerald City for its people.

During his time in Oz, he also skillfully placed a heart inside the Tin Woodman's breast.

label: History
value: Zeb was a farm worker.
unit: Zeb was a farm worker who was driving Dorothy to Hugson's Ranch in a buggy drawn by his horse, Jim, when an earthquake caused the ground to split and plunged them all into a subterranean chasm. After floating down into an underground glass city, Zeb and his companions were accused of causing the earthquake damage and eventually trapped in the dark Black Pit by the local Mangaboo people. They escaped upward through a mountain tunnel into the Valley of Voe and journeyed to Pyramid Mountain, ascending its interior stairs until reaching the wooden Country of the Gargoyles. When the silent Gargoyles captured the group, Zeb bravely snuck out while the creatures slept to steal eight unhooked wooden wings, which were then attached to Jim and the buggy so the travelers could fly away. After navigating further caverns and reaching a dead end, Princess Ozma used her Magic Belt to rescue the party, magically transporting Zeb, the Wizard, Jim, and the piglets to the Emerald City. While enjoying fine Oz clothes and royal hospitality, Zeb participated in outdoor games where he wrestled and boxed a Munchkin boy. Shortly after helping Dorothy check on their home using Ozma's enchanted picture, Zeb chose to return and was transported by the Magic Belt alongside Jim back to Hugson's Ranch.

label: v3 · The Fate of the Tin Woodman
value: Dorothy steals the Nome King's magic belt.
chapter: v3 · The Fate of the Tin Woodman
unit: Dorothy steals the Nome King's magic belt while he is blinded by egg yolks, stripping him of his power to transform the group into scorpions. Using the belt, Dorothy reopens the passage out of the mountain and threatens the King until he tries to retrieve the transformed Tin Woodman, only to find the object missing. Giving up on finding Nick Chopper, the party escapes through the tunnel, using the belt to fend off pursuing Nome warriors and bypass the iron giant on their way back to Ev.

When Toto knocks over a screen in the Throne Room, Oz is revealed to be an ordinary old man and ventriloquist from Omaha who has been fooling everyone. Despite admitting he is a humbug without real magic, he promises to grant the group their requests the following day.

label: v2 · Jack Pumpkinhead’s Ride to the Emerald City
value: Tip, Jack, and the Saw-Horse cross a wide river.
chapter: v2 · Jack Pumpkinhead’s Ride to the Emerald City
unit: Tip, Jack, and the Saw-Horse cross a wide river by swimming across. Tip commands the Saw-Horse to trot, but the horse speeds off too quickly, snapping its tail off in Tip's hands and leaving the boy behind. Jack and the Saw-Horse arrive at the Emerald City, where the Guardian of the Gates and the Soldier with the Green Whiskers put green spectacles on them and escort Jack to see the Scarecrow.

chapter: v2 · His Majesty the Scarecrow
unit: Jack Pumpkinhead meets the Scarecrow King, but due to a misunderstanding, Jack believes they speak different languages. The Soldier with the Green Whiskers fetches Jellia Jamb to act as an interpreter, though she uses the opportunity to trick and tease both of them. Once Jellia reveals that everyone in Oz speaks the same language, the Scarecrow and Jack clear up the confusion and agree to become friends.

chapter: v2 · The Tin-Woodman Plucks a Rose
unit: Glinda's army arrives and surrounds the Emerald City, demanding that Queen Jinjur hand over Mombi. Mombi uses magic to disguise Jellia Jamb as herself, but Glinda sees through the trick and demands the real witch. When Glinda's forces enter the city to search, Mombi transforms into a red rose, which the Tin Woodman plucks and unwittingly carries out of the city into Glinda's camp.

unit: The Cowardly Lion awakens and rejoins Dorothy, the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, and Toto as they journey along the yellow brick road toward the Emerald City. They spend the night at a farm house, where a local man tells them about the mysterious Great Oz and his ability to grant their wishes. The next day, the group reaches the gates of the Emerald City, where the Guardian locks green-tinted spectacles onto each of them before leading them inside.

label: v1 · Chapter I The Cyclone
value: Dorothy lives in an environment in Kansas.
chapter: v1 · Chapter I The Cyclone
unit: Dorothy lives in a drab, gray environment in Kansas with her Uncle Henry, Aunt Em, and her playful dog Toto. A sudden and severe cyclone strikes the farm, prompting Uncle Henry to tend to the livestock and Aunt Em to take shelter in the cyclone cellar. Delayed while retrieving Toto, Dorothy is trapped inside the small house as it is lifted high into the air by the storm, where she eventually relaxes and falls asleep as it floats away.

value: Dorothy wakes up.

unit: Dorothy and the Scarecrow wake up and discover the Tin Woodman, rusted motionless in the forest. After Dorothy oils his joints, he joins their journey to the Emerald City in hopes of getting a heart from Oz. As they continue along the yellow brick road, the Tin Woodman recounts how the Wicked Witch of the East cursed his axe, leading to his tin transformation and loss of his heart.

value: Dorothy leaves the Emerald City
chapter: v1 · Chapter XII The Search for the Wicked Witch
unit: Dorothy and her companions leave the Emerald City and travel west to find the Wicked Witch. The Witch spots them from her castle and sends wolves, crows, bees, and Winkie soldiers to destroy them, but Dorothy's friends defeat each wave. Finally, the Witch uses the Golden Cap to summon the Winged Monkeys, who destroy the Scarecrow and Tin Woodman, capture the Lion, and carry Dorothy and Toto to the Witch's castle, where Dorothy is made a servant while secretly helping the imprisoned Lion.

unit: A fierce storm strikes the ship carrying Dorothy and Uncle Henry on their way to Australia. Fearing her frail uncle has gone on deck in danger, Dorothy goes outside to find him, only to be blown overboard while holding onto a wooden chicken coop. Swept away into the sea, she manages to use the floating coop as a raft and eventually falls asleep once the storm subsides.

unit: Dorothy steals the Nome King's magic belt while he is blinded by egg yolks, stripping him of his power to transform the group into scorpions. value: Dorothy steals the Nome King's magic belt.
chapter: v3 · The Fate of the Tin Woodman
unit: Dorothy steals the Nome King's magic belt while he is blinded by egg yolks, stripping him of his power to transform the group into scorpions. Using the belt, Dorothy reopens the passage out of the mountain and threatens the King until he tries to retrieve the transformed Tin Woodman, only to find the object missing. Giving up on finding Nick Chopper, the party escapes through the tunnel, using the belt to fend off pursuing Nome warriors and bypass the iron giant on their way back to Ev.

unit: Tiktok defends Dorothy and Billina from the Wheelers using a tin dinner pail, capturing the Wheeler leader and learning the secret that Wheelers only pretend to be fierce. unit: General Jinjur refuses to step down, prompting Glinda and Princess Ozma to launch an aerial assault using the Gump to enter the Emerald City and capture her. Before the Tin Woodman and the Scarecrow depart for the Winkie country, Ozma commends them for their rich virtues of heart and brain.

Before the Tin Woodman and the Scarecrow depart for the Winkie country, Ozma commends them for their rich virtues of heart and brain.

unit: General Jinjur summons Mombi to help defeat the Scarecrow and Tin Woodman, and Mombi uses magic to create a confusing field of whirling, face-bearing sunflowers that delays the travelers. chapter: v2 · A Highly Magnified History
unit: The Woggle-Bug explains his origin, how he gained education by listening to a schoolmaster, and how he became enlarged after being displayed on a magnifying screen. He accepts an invitation from Tip and the group to join them on their journey to the Emerald City. When the issue of the Saw-Horse's broken leg arises, the Woggle-Bug suggests using one of Jack Pumpkinhead's legs to fix it, allowing the party to resume their travel.

unit: While traveling, the Woggle-Bug annoys the group with puns until the Scarecrow and Tin Woodman tell him to restrain himself. unit: The Scarecrow and his allies enter the Emerald City and march to the royal palace, where they find General Jinjur occupying the throne. Jinjur signals her Army of Revolt to ambush and disarm the group, threatening them with execution. The Scarecrow releases mice hidden in his straw, causing the female rebels and Jinjur to flee in panic, allowing the group to secure the palace doors.

value: The group gathers various odd items on the roof.
chapter: v2 · The Astonishing Flight of the Gump
unit: The group gathers various odd items on the roof to construct an escape flying machine. Led by Nick Chopper's assembly of sofas, palm leaves, ropes, a broom tail, and a mounted Gump head, Tip uses the remaining Powder of Life to bring the Gump creature to life. After a wild burst of flapping nearly blows them off the roof, Tip successfully commands the newly animated Gump to return and settle back down.

label: v2 · In the Jackdaw’s Nest
value: The newly revived Gump converses with Tip
chapter: v2 · In the Jackdaw’s Nest
unit: The newly revived Gump converses with Tip and his companions before flying them all south toward Glinda the Good. During the night flight, Tip discovers a hidden compartment in the pepper-box containing Dr. Nikidik's Wishing Pills, though the strange instructions leave them unsure how to use them. At dawn, realizing the Gump has flown them completely out of the Land of Oz, Tip orders a landing on a mountain cliff, which results in a crash into a giant Jackdaw nest where the group becomes trapped.

chapter: v2 · The Scarecrow Appeals to Glinda the Good
unit: The travelers fly on the Gump to the South Country and arrive safely at the palace of Glinda the Good. They seek Glinda's help to liberate the Emerald City, but she explains that the throne rightly belongs to Princess Ozma, who was hidden by the Wizard. After studying her records, Glinda deduces that the old witch Mombi helped hide Ozma, and she resolves to march her army to the Emerald City to capture Mombi and uncover the truth.

chapter: v2 · The Riches of Content
unit: General Jinjur refuses to step down, prompting Glinda and Princess Ozma to launch an aerial assault using the Gump to enter the Emerald City and capture her. With the Revolt ended, Ozma is crowned Queen, restoring order to the kingdom and dismantling the Gump upon its own request. Before the Tin Woodman and the Scarecrow depart for the Winkie country, Ozma commends them for their rich virtues of heart and brain.

value: The travelers fly on the Gump to the South Country.
chapter: v2 · The Scarecrow Appeals to Glinda the Good
unit: The travelers fly on the Gump to the South Country and arrive safely at the palace of Glinda the Good. They seek Glinda's help to liberate the Emerald City, but she explains that the throne rightly belongs to Princess Ozma, who was hidden by the Wizard. After studying her records, Glinda deduces that the old witch Mombi helped hide Ozma, and she resolves to march her army to the Emerald City to capture Mombi and uncover the truth.

Before the Tin Woodman and the Scarecrow depart for the Winkie country, Ozma commends them for their rich virtues of heart and brain.

chapter: v4 · CHAPTER 15. ContentsOLD FRIENDS ARE REUNITED
unit: The Wizard, Zeb, and Jim are welcomed to the palace in the Emerald City by Jellia Jamb, and Jim is given a room inside the palace. chapter: v4 · CHAPTER 18. ContentsTHE TRIAL OF EUREKA THE KITTEN
unit: When one of the Wizard's piglets goes missing from Ozma's room, suspicion falls upon Dorothy's kitten Eureka. Eureka acts defiance and is arrested by Ozma to face trial for murder, leading Ozma to set up a court proceeding and assign roles to their friends. Desperate to spare Dorothy grief, the Wizard gives the Tin Woodman a spare piglet to hide so he can produce it and clear Eureka if she is convicted.

value: The trial of Eureka takes place in the Throne Room.
chapter: v4 · CHAPTER 19. ContentsTHE WIZARD PERFORMS ANOTHER TRICK
unit: The trial of Eureka takes place in the Throne Room, with the Woggle-Bug prosecuting and the Tin Woodman attempting to defend her. The jury initially finds Eureka guilty, but the Tin Woodman interrupts the execution by producing a piglet from his hat. However, Eureka points out that the piglet lacks an emerald collar, prompting her to finally reveal that the real piglet is trapped inside a narrow vase in Ozma's room.

chapter: v2 · A Highly Magnified History
unit: The Woggle-Bug explains his origin, how he gained education by listening to a schoolmaster, and how he became enlarged after being displayed on a magnifying screen. He accepts an invitation from Tip and the group to join them on their journey to the Emerald City. When the issue of the Saw-Horse's broken leg arises, the Woggle-Bug suggests using one of Jack Pumpkinhead's legs to fix it, allowing the party to resume their travel.

chapter: v2 · Old Mombi indulges in Witchcraft
unit: While traveling, the Woggle-Bug annoys the group with puns until the Scarecrow and Tin Woodman tell him to restrain himself. The party encounters the Queen of the Field Mice, who lends twelve mice to hide in the Scarecrow's straw and guides them past several of Mombi's illusions. Led safely by the Mouse Queen, the travelers overcome the magical obstacles and arrive outside the Emerald City.

unit: The Scarecrow and his allies enter the Emerald City and march to the royal palace, where they find General Jinjur occupying the throne. Jinjur signals her Army of Revolt to ambush and disarm the group, threatening them with execution. The Scarecrow releases mice hidden in his straw, causing the female rebels and Jinjur to flee in panic, allowing the group to secure the palace doors.

value: The group is trapped inside the palace by Jinjur's army.
chapter: v2 · The Scarecrow Takes Time to Think
unit: Trapped inside the palace by Jinjur's army, the group despairs over their situation until the Scarecrow devises a plan to escape by air. Tip reveals he has one last dose of the Powder of Life, so the Scarecrow suggests building a flying machine on the roof and bringing it to life. After Nick Chopper fixes Jack Pumpkinhead's leg with a wooden table leg, the companions set out to search the palace for materials.

value: The group gathers various odd items on the roof.
chapter: v2 · The Astonishing Flight of the Gump
unit: The group gathers various odd items on the roof to construct an escape flying machine. Led by Nick Chopper's assembly of sofas, palm leaves, ropes, a broom tail, and a mounted Gump head, Tip uses the remaining Powder of Life to bring the Gump creature to life. After a wild burst of flapping nearly blows them off the roof, Tip successfully commands the newly animated Gump to return and settle back down.

label: v4 · CHAPTER 15. ContentsOLD FRIENDS ARE REUNITED
value: The Wizard, Zeb, and Jim are welcomed to the palace in the Emerald City by Jellia Jamb.
chapter: v4 · CHAPTER 15. ContentsOLD FRIENDS ARE REUNITED
unit: The Wizard, Zeb, and Jim are welcomed to the palace in the Emerald City by Jellia Jamb, and Jim is given a room inside the palace. Zeb gets dressed in fine Oz clothing before attending a dinner with Dorothy, Ozma, and the Wizard, where the Wizard explains his origins and history in Oz. Princess Ozma offers the Wizard a permanent home as Official Wizard, and several of Dorothy's old friends—including the Scarecrow, Billina, Eureka, the Tin Woodman, and the Woggle-Bug—arrive to reunite with them.

unit: A grand parade takes place through the Emerald City in honor of the visitors, after which the Wizard performs magic tricks for the crowd in the Throne Room. After Jim angrily kicks the Sawhorse, the Tiger knocks Jim over, but order is restored and Ozma crowns the Sawhorse as Prince of Horses.

value: One of the Wizard's piglets goes missing from Ozma's room.
chapter: v4 · CHAPTER 18. ContentsTHE TRIAL OF EUREKA THE KITTEN
unit: When one of the Wizard's piglets goes missing from Ozma's room, suspicion falls upon Dorothy's kitten Eureka. Eureka acts defiance and is arrested by Ozma to face trial for murder, leading Ozma to set up a court proceeding and assign roles to their friends. Desperate to spare Dorothy grief, the Wizard gives the Tin Woodman a spare piglet to hide so he can produce it and clear Eureka if she is convicted.

label: v1 · Chapter VI The Cowardly Lion
value: Dorothy and her companions encounter a roaring Lion while traveling through a thick forest.
chapter: v1 · Chapter VI The Cowardly Lion
unit: While traveling through a thick forest, Dorothy and her companions encounter a roaring Lion who attacks the Scarecrow and Tin Woodman, then threatens Toto. Dorothy slaps the Lion on the nose and calls him a coward, prompting the Lion to admit his secret lack of courage. He decides to join their journey to the Great Oz to request courage, and later in the day, the Scarecrow uses an oil-can to free the Tin Woodman's rusted jaws after the Woodman cries over accidentally stepping on a beetle.

label: v1 · Chapter VII The Journey to the Great Oz
value: Dorothy and her companions camp in the forest.
chapter: v1 · Chapter VII The Journey to the Great Oz
unit: After camping in the forest, Dorothy and her companions encounter a deep ditch blocking the yellow brick road. The Cowardly Lion carries each traveler across on his back. Later, they face another wide chasm and chop down a tree to form a bridge, but are pursued by fearsome Kalidahs; the Scarecrow orders the tree chopped down just as the beasts cross, sending them into the abyss. Reaching a broad river at the edge of the forest, the group makes camp while the Tin Woodman begins building a raft to cross.

unit: The travelers attempt to cross the river on a raft, but the swift current sweeps them off course and leaves the Scarecrow stuck on a pole.
